cards.ex: You need to be thick-skinned to survive in this business.
cards.exUz: Bu biznesda omon qolish uchun qalin terili bo'lish kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tanqidga chidamli, oson xafa bo'lmaydigan odam.

cards.ex: He always calls a spade a spade, which sometimes gets him into trouble.
cards.exUz: U har doim ochiq gapiradi, bu ba'zan uni muammoga solib qo'yadi.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ri va ochiq gapirish, muloyimlik qilmaslik.

cards.ex: The actor had a larger than life personality that captivated audiences.
cards.exUz: Aktyorning ajoyib shaxsiyati tomoshabinlarni o'ziga tortdi.
cards.uzDef: O'ziga xos, hayratlanarli, odatdagidan ko'ra qiziqarli odam.

cards.ex: Despite his fame, he's still a very down-to-earth guy.
cards.exUz: Mashhurligiga qaramay, u hali ham juda oddiy yigit.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy, real hayotga yaqin, sun'iylikdan uzoq odam.

cards.ex: I wanted to set the record straight about what really happened that night.
cards.exUz: O'sha kecha nima bo'lgani haqida haqiqatni aytmoqchi edim.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri tushunchalarni to'g'rilash, haqiqatni ochish.

cards.ex: Don't be such a wet blanket! Try to enjoy yourself.
cards.exUz: Bunchalik zerikarli bo'lma! O'zingdan zavqlanishga harakat qil.
cards.uzDef: Quvonchni buzadigan, kayfiyatni tushiradigan odam.

cards.ex: She's such a people pleaser; she always agrees with everyone.
cards.exUz: U shunchalik xushomadgo'yki, har doim hamma bilan rozi bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Hamma bilan yaxshi munosabatda bo'lishga harakat qiladigan odam.

cards.ex: The boss only wants yes-men around him; he doesn't value dissenting opinions.
cards.exUz: Boshliq faqat o'z atrofida qo'g'irchoqlarni xohlaydi; u boshqa fikrlarni qadrlamaydi.
cards.uzDef: Boshliqning har qanday fikriga 'ha' deydigan odam.

cards.ex: I said some things in the heat of the moment that I regret now.
cards.exUz: G'azabda shunday narsalarni aytdimki, hozir afsusdaman.
cards.term: in the heat of the moment
cards.uzDef: Juda hayajonlangan yoki g'azablangan paytda.

cards.ex: He's used to getting his own way, so he's not happy when he doesn't.
cards.exUz: U o'z so'zini o'tkazishga o'rganib qolgan, shuning uchun u xursand emas.
cards.uzDef: O'z xohishiga erishish, boshqalarni ko'ndirish.

cards.ex: Dealing with all the paperwork is a real pain in the neck.
cards.exUz: Hujjatlar bilan ishlash juda bosh og'rig'i.
cards.uzDef: Jonga tegadigan, bezovta qiladigan odam yoki narsa.

cards.ex: He's a loose cannon; you never know what he's going to do next.
cards.exUz: U boshqarib bo'lmas; keyin nima qilishini hech qachon bilmaysiz.
cards.uzDef: Oldindan aytib bo'lmaydigan, xavfli odam.

cards.ex: He tends to rub people the wrong way with his bluntness.
cards.exUz: U o'zining ochiqligi bilan odamlarning g'ashiga tegadi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir g'azablantirmoq, yoqimsiz ta'sir qilmoq.

cards.ex: You need to get a grip and stop panicking.
cards.exUz: O'zingni bosishing va vahima qilishing kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'zini tuta bilmoq, hissiyotlarini nazorat qilish.

cards.ex: Stop being so childish and act your age.
cards.exUz: Bunchalik bolalarcha bo'lishni bas qil va yoshinga mos bo'l.
cards.uzDef: O'z yoshiga mos ravishda harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: My grandfather is a creature of habit; he has the same breakfast every day.
cards.exUz: Mening bobom odat quli; u har kuni bir xil nonushta qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Doim bir xil ishni qiladigan, o'zgarishni yoqtirmaydigan odam.

cards.ex: She's a tough cookie; she can handle anything life throws at her.
cards.exUz: U qattiq odam; u hayotda unga nima topshirsa ham, uddalay oladi.
cards.uzDef: Kuchli, chidamli, osonlik bilan taslim bo'lmaydigan odam.

cards.ex: Our new assistant is really on the ball; she gets everything done quickly and efficiently.
cards.exUz: Yangi yordamchimiz juda sergak; u hamma narsani tez va samarali bajaradi.
cards.uzDef: Tezkor, e'tiborli, ishni yaxshi bajaradigan odam.

cards.ex: His constant complaining is starting to get under my skin.
cards.exUz: Uning doimiy shikoyatlari mening asabimga tega boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir g'azablantirmoq, bezovta qilmoq.

cards.ex: I'm a people watcher; I love sitting in cafes and observing the passersby.
cards.exUz: Men odam kuzatuvchiman; men kafelarda o'tirib, o'tib ketayotganlarni kuzatishni yaxshi ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarni kuzatishdan zavqlanadigan odam.

cards.ex: As a leader, you need to set an example for your team.
cards.exUz: Rahbar sifatida siz o'z jamoangizga namuna bo'lishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalar uchun yaxshi xulq-atvor ko'rsatmoq, o'rnak bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: He's a quiet man who keeps himself to himself.
cards.exUz: U tinch odam, o'ziga qarab yuradi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalar bilan aralashmaslik, o'z olamida bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: He knew he had to face the music for his mistakes.
cards.exUz: U xatolari uchun javobgarlikka tortilishi kerakligini bilardi.
cards.uzDef: Xatolaringiz uchun javobgarlikka tortilish.

cards.ex: You're pushing your luck by driving so fast.
cards.exUz: Siz bunchalik tez haydab omadingizni sinayapsiz.
cards.uzDef: Omadli vaziyatni haddan tashqari ishlatishga harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: She rose to the occasion and delivered an amazing presentation.
cards.exUz: U vaziyatga moslashdi va ajoyib taqdimot qildi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatda yaxshi harakat qilmoq, uddalamoq.

cards.ex: You have to take the bull by the horns and deal with the problem head-on.
cards.exUz: Siz muammoni jasorat bilan hal qilishingiz kerak.
cards.term: take the bull by the horns
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatni jasorat bilan hal qilishga kirishmoq.

cards.ex: I got a bit carried away with the decorations for the party.
cards.exUz: Men ziyofat uchun bezaklarga biroz berilib ketdim.
cards.uzDef: Hissiyotlar ta'sirida haddan tashqari harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: You'd have to have a heart of stone not to feel sorry for them.
cards.exUz: Ularga achinmaslik uchun tosh yurakga ega bo'lishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Rahmsiz, mehrsiz odam.

cards.ex: I get a kick out of watching old movies.
cards.exUz: Men eski filmlarni tomosha qilishdan zavqlanaman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadandir katta zavq olmoq, qiziqish bilan qaramoq.

cards.ex: I'm still on the fence about whether to accept the job offer.
cards.exUz: Men hali ham ish taklifini qabul qilish yoki qilmaslik haqida ikkilanyapman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida qaror qabul qila olmaslik, ikkilanish.
